answer: The pulse cap is enforced at intake and voyage shows the per-origin counts. At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a umber tag. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a fleet in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, as each account consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. Each copy needs 7 hours of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
